usage: deskops graph [-h] {build,neighbors,missing,reflect} ...

Build and inspect deskops KGDB graph runtime outputs.

positional arguments:
  {build,neighbors,missing,reflect}
    build               Build the KGDB graph snapshot runtime artifact.
    neighbors           Show incoming and outgoing neighbors for one graph
                        node.
    missing             Report missing graph targets and dangling declared
                        references.
    reflect             Write review-only self-reflection findings for a graph
                        snapshot.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
